0022600028.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-4, 2-2 at home, on a two-game losing streak, 11th in the West) host the Utah Jazz (1-7, on a six-game losing streak, 14th in the West) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, Dallas's 9th of the season. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (out, knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (out, heel inflammation), while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (out, knee), Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot strain), and Trey Alexander (out, knee bruise). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and Dallas won their most recent meeting 138-120 in Dallas on January 17, 2026.
